about_the_game:
Are you a typical 2020s gamer? Want all the dopamine from winning without actually doing anything? I present: I WIN! A tiny joke game for gamers who hate playing games. Press one button, unlock all achievements, and bask in your instant victory!

Unlock all 10 achievements with just a click of a button.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7 SP1+, Windows 10, or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or better)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
